profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Hard-driving hunters, American Curs were developed for practical work rather than a uniform appearance. They locate and tree game, with some lines also serving as stock dogs and guardians. Mountain Curs combine intelligence with a desire to please, while Black Mouth Curs are noted for courage, tenacity and loyalty to their family.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A versatile American working family, Curs include determined tree hunters, stock dogs and loyal guardians, with varied temperaments.
